match: a cylinder — labels like "cylinder", "3d cylinder", "hình trụ", "trụ tròn", "khối trụ", "can", or a tube/can sketch (ellipse caps with straight sides)
params: {"radius": 0.3-1.4, "height": 0.6-3.0; "flat": true|false — start flattened/unfolded; "slice": true|false — open the slicing plane; "tilt": 0-180, "offset": -1.4..1.4, "spin": 0-360, "cut": "full"|"above"|"below"} — all optional
